title: Pompeii's 2,000-year-old 'Cave Canem' shows Romans had dog warnings too
description: The ancient 'CAVE CANEM' sign, translating to 'Beware of the Dog,' hails from Pompeii, serving as both an alert and a safety barrier against thieves. In Roman times, robust dogs were favored for their protective nature. The design of entryways showcased a homeowner's status and notions of security. This timeless warning resonates even in today's world, with contemporary adaptations of caution signs standing guard.

title: 'Villa scam': IPS Prashakha Mathur now put on APO; IAS husband currently abroad

The probe, initiated by the Anti-Corruption Bureau, investigates allegations that Agrawal improperly assisted Goyal Fashions Pvt Ltd, garnering personal benefits. Evidence indicates the couple obtained villas at below-market prices in exchange for such favors. If the claims hold true, Agrawal could face legal repercussions.

title: Trump speaks to Netanyahu as US weighs fresh military strikes on Iran: Report

The situation remains tense as military preparations are reported by US and Israeli defense forces.

She was introduced to sports by the Indian Army and trained under Coach Kuldeep Vedwan. At the 2026 Asian Para Games, she won two gold medals and one silver, defending her previous titles successfully. Her achievements inspire children with disabilities to pursue sports and contribute positively to their lives.

Police are investigating the school's supervision and have registered a complaint against the principal and teacher. Experts have called for early intervention to address children’s aggression and the need for psychological support.

title: 24 years later: Pakistan recreate India's Lord's magic with record-equalling chase
description: Pakistan produced a memorable run chase to beat Sri Lanka by three wickets in the One-Day International tri-series final in Lahore on Saturday. Fakhar Zaman led the charge with a brilliant century as the hosts chased down a target of 326 with nine balls to spare. Pakistan finished on 331 for seven in 48.3 overs to register the joint-highest successful chase in an ODI final. Pakistan equalled India's famous record against England in the 2002 NatWest Series final at Lord's.

These initiatives will encompass vehicle-entry limitations, reduced office attendance, and increased parking fees. description: A legal battle erupted between a California restaurant and the family of a golfer regarding a surprise catering bill. The eatery served meals during the prestigious Masters tournament without prior discussion of costs. After leaving prematurely, the family was charged nearly $75,000, which they contested in court. Ultimately, the jury awarded the restaurant $60,391, albeit the request for extra attorney fees was mostly denied.

title: 4.1bn-year-old pink Mars rock found in Sahara holds clues to ancient water
description: Discovered in the vast Sahara Desert, the meteorite Teghaza 001 is over four billion years old and is confirmed to be a Martian rock via isotopic studies. This intriguing specimen reveals a volcanic history intertwined with water activity, indicating a complex water cycle on Mars. As researchers delve deeper into its origins, they are unraveling vital insights into the planet's early environmental conditions.

title: Watch: Chaos at B'luru airport as flyer finds chicken in veg biriyani
description: Piyush Agarwal, a vegetarian flyer, discovered meat in a biryani at Taste of India restaurant. The incident occurred at Kempegowda International Airport, causing significant distress to his family. Agarwal stated that even his children unknowingly consumed the non-vegetarian food served to them. He requested an investigation by the relevant authorities regarding the matter. Airport officials acknowledged the incident and are currently conducting an internal review to understand the situation.

Hope Diamond was mailed in a plain brown package for just $145 in 1958
description: The Hope Diamond embarked on a remarkable journey in 1958 when it was sent as registered mail to the Smithsonian Institution for safekeeping. This precious gem, with its origins in India, has a captivating royal history. American jeweller Harry Winston generously donated it to the museum after obtaining it from Evalyn Walsh McLean's estate in 1949.

title: Greek shipwreck's 2,000-year-old device was built to predict eclipses
description: In 1900, a remarkable discovery was made when divers stumbled upon the Antikythera Mechanism amidst a shipwreck in the Mediterranean Sea. This ancient artifact showcased astounding knowledge of astronomy and mechanical engineering dating back over 2,000 years. Researchers found it capable of calculating astronomical cycles and predicting eclipses, intertwining science with the cultural tapestry of ancient Greece.

title: Pilibhit voter roll row: UP CEO orders statewide ECINET login shutdown
description: Uttar Pradesh Chief Electoral Officer Navdeep Rinwa has taken stringent action against voter registration irregularities. He ordered the deactivation of login IDs used by voter registration centre operators. Following an inquiry, an outsourced computer assistant was terminated for their alleged involvement. District election officers have been instructed to verify the deactivation of these IDs promptly. The CEO emphasized the importance of maintaining the integrity of electoral roll management.

title: Man rescued a 2kg bear cub; the 150kg bear still tries to sit on his lap
description: In 2019, electrician Petar Tubic stumbled upon a deserted bear cub named Masa in the woods. Over time, he nurtured Masa, eventually establishing a sanctuary for rescued animals, which now includes an additional bear, Ljubica. However, Tubic is troubled by their strong human bonds, raising concern over the bears' future. The sanctuary has transformed into a community attraction and draws attention to the complexities involved in wildlife rescue.

title: Book: Kanye West showed up unannounced, stayed 4 days at $295m Malibu mansion
description: Kanye West made an unplanned visit to a stunning Malibu mansion crafted by Tadao Ando, spending four days there. He secured a stay without prior arrangement, likening his presence to that of Elvis Presley. Meanwhile, the estate was later sold to Jay-Z and Beyoncé, breaking sales records. West's personal Ando-designed property, however, is grappling with legal and financial troubles, leaving its future uncertain due to ongoing foreclosure issues.
